The flower that the horse dun ate with all his other feed

#4433 1 2005-07-25T18:47:46Z Trogdor007
All the following have been suggested several times. Some are technically impossible or difficult, some are already available in some form, some go against the philosophy behind the game, and some are just considered silly, uninteresting, or otherwise Not A Good Idea. Please don't suggest them again, because they'll just get shot down again, and angry people with no patience will probably get upset with you.

This is by no means a complete list of everything which has been suggested repeatedly. Before posting in this section, please use the search tool to look for similar suggestions. N, in particular, has been around for quite a while, and most of the suggestions we get these days have already been made.

EDIT- AIS is As It Sounds

Suggestions for N and N+

Doors:
- timed doors (doors that remain open for a limited time)
- color switches (a blue switch opens all blue doors)
- numbered switches (switches must be done in order to open door)
- trip lasers (like trap doors.)
- Angled doors (AIS)
- force field (a force field that acts as a round door to be unlocked)
- toggle doors (AIS)

Enemies:
- Motion detector drone (only attack when they see you move)
- Motion detector gauss (only shoot when they see you move)
- Ghost drones (Drones that can go through walls)
- Drones able to damage each other (NO!)
- fire drone (a drone with a flame thrower)
- following laser drone (A gauss laser drone)
- Ice drone (a drone that can freeze N for a few seconds)
- sticky drone (a drone that makes N slower)
- button pressing drones (drones that can press switches)
- moving gauss drones (moving gauss drones)
- dart laser (a drone that shoots darts)
- spikes (spikes to impale the ninja - just use mines!)
- stationary laser (AIS)
- super cannon (an advanced Gauss)
- spear shooter (a gauss that shoots spears)
- evil N (an N drone)
- Samurai (play along side S who will race you to the exit. If you cross him, he'll slice you)
- Set path zap drones (set the path for the zap drone to go on)
- boss enemies (bigger drones at the end of a column)

Objects:
- level (horizontal) flip switch (Flips level so you play upside down)
- N repeller/attractor (Fans and Vacuum)
- No jump/walk tile (tiles that you can't walk or jump on)
- push blocks (blocks that N can push)
- lifts (elevators)

Aesthetics - graphics, sound, etc.
- themes- Fire, Ice, Trees (a lot like lode runner)
- Any other kind of background graphics
- Different graphics for objects/enemies
- Different sounds for objects/enemies
- play along side high scores (have the demo play next to your ninja for practise)
- female ninja (The ninja's gender is never specified. You can consider her female if you wish.)
- full screen (AIS)
- no blood (a kids mode)
- Soundtrack (Just use your own music and a media player)

Tiles:
- New tile shapes.
- vector based maps (Would require entire game engine to be re-written)

Game mechanics/ninja abilities:
- N grapple gun (A ninja's rope shooting device) (Buy Robotology, Metanet's next game)
- Weaponry or combat. It's NOT going to happen, so don't bother posting it, please. This includes non-lethal weapons, like EMP blasts, smoke grenades, and the like.
- upside down N (allow N to run on ceiling)
- side scroller (a lot like sonic or cave story)
- multiplayer in the PC version (Buy N+, for DS, PSP or XBLA. Metanet will not implement multiplayer for PC due to technical difficulties.)
- lie down button (a crouch button, to allow N to move through tight spaces.)
- duck button (quack)
- Health, two hit kills, or anything similar.
- slow motion (During the game, that is. Not during replays.)
- Light (have dark areas where you can't see, and light areas where you can)
-SUPER N! (N gets superpowers)
- invisibility (stealth mode)
- a really long, red, scarf (Clothes and accessories)
- any other kind of clothing
- Lava/water pools (Lava burns N, Water makes him swim)
- bigger maps (varying map sizes)
- Wrap-around (allow N to go off to the right and come back on the left.)
- double jumping (Like in mario)
- faster (let N run faster)
- modulations for n (invincability, faster, stronger)
- easy mode (AIS)

Randomness (aka Miscellaneous)
- DDA reward for each episode beaten (as it sounds)
- jump to level (Use the existing cheats or practice mode.)
- tricks section (a section where it reveals the tricks of your ninja)
- speed bar (a bar that shows how fast you're going out of how fast you can go)
- online volleyball (WHAT!?)

Suggestions for Robotology

Coming soon! Once the game is actually released, for instance...

If you've seen something which has been suggested over and over, and it's not on this list, please PM one of the staff and ask to have it added.

Who here has read the book "You Are Special"?

Fantastic children's book. It's the story of this large colony of wooden people, all of whom carry stickers: Gold Stars and Gray Dots. The people give the stars for good deeds, and gray dots. However, there is one wooden boy named James, and he was a waiter. He dropped a tray in public, so everyone put a Gray dot on him. From then on, the people saw his gray dots and thought that they should give him more, because he's obviously a no good person. He eventually meets a woman named Stacy, who has NO stickers. He's shocked. He finds out that she simply doesn't want them to stick, so they don't. People see she has no gray dots, so they give her gold stars. They fall off. People see she has no gold stars, so they bestow gray dots on her. They too, fall off.

She brings james to "The Puppet Master" who has carved them all. He explains that everyone is special and should define themselves... Don't worry about everyone's opinion of you. You always should ignore the insults and compliments, and simply be as you are.

Like I said, fantastic book.

(Not directed at anyone on this forum)
You poke at me. You kick out my feet when I stand. You gnaw at my every word, looking for a mistake to prod at. You mock my every syllable, glare at every stanza. You go out of your way to make me look bad, and for what? To make yourself look better? Do you find yourself drowning in a sea of self-doubt? Am I your only hope of flotation? Must you put your weight on my shoulder and hold my head under, leaving me to gasp for air?

Every blow I take from your words, or from your actions, you set my self-esteem down a notch.

I may walk across a desert filled with noxious fumes, and with each breath I take I shorten my life, but I will never[/color] stumble. But when I walk into a room, and you glance and snicker, I hit the floor and bleed inside.

If I came into this world as a giant, then with each step I take I grow shorter.

You may see me as a person now, but why must you dehumanize me when with others? Do you feel power when you kick a crippled deer? And why do you think that your friends laugh? It is because they feel that if they don't, you will think they are inferior? Both ends are trying to impress each other, and yet neither is pleased.

I am seeing self esteem as a belt. Same with ego. Both are belts you want to fill.

Is an asshole still an asshole if he is blind? Why must those with differences be treated as the same when dealing with positive reinforcement, and not with punishments? If a man with a form of mental retardation that simply affected his artistic side makes a mistake in judgment that results in someone's life, is it the mental retardation, or the man's fault?

You make take my belt of self esteem and ego and take it down a notch all you want. But it's made of cardboard, so I will never cease to add two notches for every one you take it down. The joke is on you, bitch! I will be sure to end my life at the top of this hill, knowing that I have led my life as I wished, and not let what you want my self-esteem to be to affect me.

#7968 1 2006-04-10T03:11:41Z Trogdor007
I've noticed in recent times how people assume we live in a three dimensional universe, but I completely disagree.

The 1st dimension is a line. Nothing more than a coordinate.

The 2nd dimension can be portrayed by a box. It existed on one plane, and is the next logical step from the line.

The 3rd dimension brings depth to the box, making a cube. Yes, I am well aware that the second two dimensions can be any shape.

Einstein brought us into the mind set that the 4th dimension would be time. And any of us familiar with the Fantasy book, "A Wrinkle In Time," will be well aware that the author believes the 5th to be a tesseract, a very popular theory, in fact. Also in the book, "A Wrinkle In Time," They bring us to thinking how an advanced universe could live their lives in twelve dimensions, and upon seeing us, see us as inferior. On that note, how if we could travel to a lesser dimension, our lungs would be crushed in the 2 dimensional environment, and our hearts implode.

Continuing, I believe that a cartoon demonstrates the existance of the 2nd dimension and the 4th, completely skipping the 3rd. The dimensions are not exactly levels, but criteria. We follow all four, but who is to say that there isn't another level of existance on top of ourselves, so far up that neither of these universes would take notice of each other, that follows a completely different criteria.

I believe the 4th dimension to be overly broad, and that it covers both time and motion. Though not always true, everything moves over time. the tallest of mountains will crumble or grow, due to the moving of tectonic plates or the constant strain of gravity.

Comments?

In this party, we truly need a man who will purchase a large cart. I say that each member should attempt to get his own food, but buy water for the team, since a barrel outweighs a few horses.

#182672 7 2006-05-31T10:54:42Z Trogdor007
Dylan's Pie Emporium was the best in the business. Everyone loved his pies! Even his quiche was exceptional. For some reason, the people said that, in his pies, the crust was better than the filling. Pie Experts (Piethologists, if you will) were mystified by this role reversal. "The crust isn't supposed to excell like this!" "This isn't natural!" they said. And so they sent it for a chemical analysis.

By this point, Dylan lonely pie shack had grown into the largest corporation in the known world (I don't know China very well, so maybe they had a bigger one), complete with an assembly line, and Viking slave drivers to keep the workers moving. "ROW! I mean, COOK, ya bastards! COOK LIKE JA LIFE DEPENDED ON IT! Which, legally, it doesn't due to our fabulous People of Pie Workers Union, or Popwoo... BUT PRETEND JA LIFE DEPENDS ON IT!" In the factory, no one knew ALL of the recipe. And none of them knew where the crust came from. It always seemed to be premade... but one man knew it all. Dylan, the Pie Master. He had grown this business from the ground up, and intended to keep branching out. Next week, he planned to open a Cake Wing. Anyone who hated pie, must've loved cake.

A few days later, and the chemical analysis returned. The Piethologists held their breath, and examined the papers. "Cocaine." one said. "That's whats in the crust!" So they called LAPD, which may have been their first mistake...

Meanwhile, Dylan was sitting at his desk overlooking the factory. On top of his desk was a mountain of pure cocaine. He leans right over it, and lowers his head, where he begins to inhale. 15 minutes and 2 lbs of cocaine later, he sits up. His sister runs in, naked, with a gun, and begins to shoot at him. Dylan hides under his desk. LAPD breaks in, and shoots Dylan's sister. Out of nowhere, Dylan pulls out a grenade launcher and several machine guns, and begins firing. He gets hit several hundred times, but is still standing, until a policeman shoots in the back. He falls over the balcony, and lands in the Fountain of Pie (which constantly shoots blueberry pie filling), dead.


So ends the life of Scarface Pieface.

Levels!

At the start:
Strong Guys get +5 for Brawling.
Crew Guys get +4 for their choice of Shooting or Specialty, and +1 for Swords.
Exploders get +5 for Demolitions.
Jail Guards get +3 for Brawling and +2 for specialty.
Crows Nest get +5 for shooting.
1st Mate gets +5 for sword.

Each player gets a discount for weapons and items that apply to his or her category. I would think 50% would suffice.

Every week on Friday, the players get to choose one category to Level Up in. The amount of points they go up is directly related to how much work they did in that area. If none was done, they will get 0. If it was a category they had no experience in, then they can go to members of the party who do have experience in say... Demolitions and train with them. This will result in +1 for each member involved.

Special Abilities (Also thought up by Pierce West!)

Each Player either gets +15, +10 (if you're a cook, look out, or medic), or +5 if you're a strong guy (In addition to whatever is automatic to their "type.") to choose where it goes.

The Kingdom of Loathing (or KoL, as it has come to be known by its player base) is a free, comical RPG, brought to you by the folks at Asymmetric Publications.

KoL is currently in open beta -- it's open to the public to play, but it's not quite finished. More features and things to do are being added on a nearly daily basis. Despite its unfinished state, it has already attracted a thriving community of interesting, intelligent, and helpful players.

KoL is, and always will be, free to play, but donations are appreciated and rewarded.

KoL is played from the comfort of your browser, and is adorned with a staggering array of stunning hand-drawn images. It is turn-based, which means you get a certain number of turns (Adventures) each day. What can you do with these turns? I'm glad you asked.


An Adventurer is You!
Choose from one of six intoxicating character classes, including:

Seal Clubber
Seal Clubbers hail from the frigid Northlands, because one character class always hails from the frigid Northlands. They rely on their Muscle to survive.
Turtle Tamer
The Turtle Tamer's mystical connection with his terrapin brethren imbues him with great power. He excels at moving very slowly and winning footraces with smug satisfaction. His Muscle is the key to his success, and to his long lifespan.
Pastamancer
With his mastery of the arcane secrets of Noodlecraft, the Pastamancer is a force to be reckoned with. He relies on his Mysticality to get ahead in the world.
Sauceror Long engaged in an uneasy truce with the Pastamancers, the guild of Saucerors protects the secrets of the Ancient Brotherhood of Gravymakers. Their Mysticality is their most important attribute.
Disco Bandit
The Disco Bandit boogies to and fro, hither and yon. Whence comes he? No man knows. Whither strikes he next? All men live in fear of him and his Moxie.
The Accordion Thief
The scourge of mariachis and polka bands, the Accordion Thieves have plied their malign craft since time out of mind. Their Moxie serves them well in both their adventures and their interactions with "the ladies."

This is the story of a freshmen at my school by the name of Dillan.

Dillan is a small boy, who was very involved on certain websites over the summer. He wasn't very popular in school, and didn't have many friends in real life. You see, Dillan is homosexual. He became very friendly with another boy on a website. They soon posted pictures of eachother on the internet, starting with headshots, but they soon took a turn for the worse, as they became much "friendlier." The pictures became ranchy and sexual, until the other boy decided that they should meet in late September. Dillan approached the decided location, finding it empty. He turned to leave, and was ambushed by a 40 year old man, who had been posing as the boy.

Dillan was kidnapped by the man posing as the boy he had fallen for.

*This is where the details get fuzzy. He was missing for about 1 week, until the police found them in a hotel room in Hartford.

The man forced Dillan out of the window and into his car. The police pursued, and the man knew that they were going to get caught, so he was going to try and kill them both. He drove his car into a brick wall, killing him instantly, but throwing Dillan from the car, and into the wall. Dillan's neck was broken, but he lived.

My lovely *cough* *cough* school system has no policy for such situations, and forced him back into school three days later. Now, with a large faith in humanity, I would expect people to have great sympathy for this boy, but no. He was completely ignored, or ridiculed for his trauma. He attempted to hang himself in the school gym, only to be discovered by a gym teacher, who ACTUALLY managed to get Dillan suspended for three days. It eventually became so bad, that a teacher, when calling on him, referred to him as "Fag" instead of his proper name. He stayed in my high school until January 10th, when he could no longer stand it. He left the school system without emptying out his locker, and his parents had him enrolled in a special school in Pennsylvania. No one has heard from Dillan since.

I believe that this is just the saddest thing that can happen as a result of the internet. But this is also why the Metacons are so safe, because they are meetings of more than 2 people, preventing this level of perversion.

The clumsy fighting styles refer mostly to the people of the Star Trek Enterprise. Keep in mind that it is not a fighting ship. None of them are. They are adventurers and explorers first. So in a "Who'd win in a fight? Star Trek or the Galactic Empire?" situation, think about the galactic empire as a whole.
Take out of the equation that the people of Star Trek aren't fighters for a second. They're pretty resourceful, so they'll get the benefit of the doubt. Now that alliance that constructs that team is composed of Earth, and choice beings from select planets. Not too many Vulcans- They want to stay out of the trials of man.
Then look at the Galactic Empire. It contains entire world civilizations. From each world, you'd take the men from the population to fight. And fighting is what the Galactic Empire does. There is no question here, that the Galactic Empire would completely obliderate them with shear organization and force. Knowing that the Empire would make the first move (as the fighting nation), they would catch the Trek off guard, and they would shamble to assemble ANY force. They would fail, save one man. Kirk. And he would rise, to kill Palpatine, but at the cost of his life.

So Star Trek lose, Star Wars win.

#15711 1 2007-06-15T20:46:45Z Trogdor007
I'm in love with this show. It's beautiful.

The entire show is based around the ancient art of bending, referring to bending an element (Fire, Water, Earth, and Air). Each art of bending is living in a different part of the world. The Air Tribe is known as the peace keepers, living in the high mountains, as monks. The Water Tribe lives on the North and South poles of the world. The Earth kingdom is in the mainland, along with the Fire empire. There is always an Avatar, who is born following the death of the prior Avatar. The Avatar is in control of all four, but must learn them all. The Fire tribe, following the death of the last Avatar, invaded the Air Tribe, and is thought to have killed them all. The Air Tribe was said to be the next to have an Avatar, but he (Aang) got away, and froze in a block of ice.

That's just a bit of this show. Each "bending" style is actually based on a form of martial arts, making the motions realistic.

I was watching a marathon today (actually, in the process of watching it now), and saw something interesting:
Fire can create fire and lightning from themselves.
Water can move water when it's already present, but can freeze it in any weather (ICE SPEAR!), and can move plants.
Earth is just "Gragh! Rock in face!" and pretty much any rock moving. Which is friggin' great.
Air is air. Yeah.

So what's up with this clear advantage in Fire and Water? Earth and Air are just those. If I'm wrong, please tell me. I'm trying to figure this all out.
#331607 3 2007-06-15T21:02:43Z Trogdor007
But the thing is the clear advantage fire has over water. Water can only move water when it's present. But fire can CREATE it!
